summary.text: Will Snyder is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 87 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Muskegon resident, he previously worked as a legislative aide and district director for former state Representative Terry Sabo.

paragraphs.text: Snyder lives in Muskegon, Michigan, and earned a high school diploma from Mona Shores High School.

He has served on the board of directors of Read Muskegon, as building association president of the Knights of Columbus Dan M. Kennedy Council #706, and as vice chair of the Muskegon County Democratic Party.
Snyder succeeded Republican Julie Calley in District 87.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the House Appropriations Committee and a select committee on protecting Michigan employees and small businesses.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Cody Chipman in the general election on November 3, 2026.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Snyder said he was first elected in 2022 and re-elected in 2024, and that he is a former member of UFCW Local 951.
He listed the costs of housing, childcare, healthcare and energy, support for collective bargaining, and improving education among his priorities.
